text: monetary inflation. If banana demand is the same and banana supply is the same, but monkeys have more leaves than usual to buy banana, banana price go up. Because now leaves are not worth as much as before. Hyperinflation. Price of banana goes up, so monkey government decides to create more leaves, so monkeys can't afford banana. So monkeys buy more banana, but banana price goes up to keep up with banana demand, so monkey government creates more leaves, but price of banana goes up to keep up with more demand, so monkey government creates more leaves, but price of banana goes up, so monkey government creates more leaves. This is getting ridiculous. Eventually, monkey government burns all the leaves and starts making sticks. It's new currency.
